steps.text: Leo wants an emergency kit packed, just in case. Find four things round town.
checklist: A water jug, by the Market fountain
A torch, from the Library steps
A cozy blanket, in the Cozy Cave
A snack box, on the dock

steps.text: Take the kit to Leo's emergency bunker, in the meadow south of the lake.
A loud wail! Leo's frozen with worry by the bunker. Talk to him.

reward.message: Leo's ready for anything now, and he says you are too. +12 sparkles.
